description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing Leave records in a database using Room persistence library. It includes methods for querying, inserting, updating, and deleting leave entries, along with searching by text and date range.

classes.name: LeaveDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object interface for performing CRUD operations and queries on Leave entities in the database.

methods.name: getAllLeaves
methods.description: Retrieves all leave entries from the database as a flow of a list.

methods.name: getLeavesByType
methods.description: Retrieves leave entries filtered by specific LeaveType.

methods.name: searchLeaves
methods.description: Searches leave entries matching a query in the title or description.

methods.name: insertLeave
methods.description: Inserts a new leave entry or replaces existing one on conflict.

methods.name: getLeavesForPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves leave entries within a specified date range.
